caption:
Your office closes Friday at 5. Your leads don't.

A homeowner searching for a contractor at 9pm on a Saturday isn't waiting for Monday. Most shops go quiet the second the doors lock, and whoever answers first usually wins the job.

Build this before next weekend: any lead that arrives after hours automatically triggers an instant text.

Script: "Thanks for reaching out to [Business]. We're closed until Monday at 8am and will call you first thing. Reply URGENT if this can't wait."

That single text covers over 60 hours of silence without losing the lead to whoever replies faster.

Build your version free with the AI Follow-Up Builder.
DM TOOLS
#ServiceBusiness #LeadFollowUp #HomeServices #SmallBusinessMarketing #SpeedToLead
rationale: Reels still win reach for cold-audience teaching content, and this fills under-served Education/Informative with an unclaimed gap (the after-hours/weekend response window) using a concrete trigger and script instead of a repeated stat.
